    Profile

    Kudan is a Spearman serving as the Captain of the 4th Regiment of the Holy Guard. He got promoted from Vice-Captain to Captain after Cadanova's death. He helped Kagura during the destruction of Wadatsumi, so he has a gentle side as well, but Cadanova has warned him that he's vulnerable to evil because of his desire for power.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Male
    Height: 182cm
    Weight: 72kg
    Birthday: Dec 7
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Nothing particular
    Hobbies: Nothing particular
    Illust: しぶ彦
